cues.en: Now, if you've looked up machine learning before, you know there's a lot out there.
cues.zh: 如果以前查過機器學習，就知道內容很多。

cues.en: Some resources recommend learning, mathematics, statistics, probability and even more before getting started with data science and machine learning.
cues.zh: 有些資源建議，開始資料科學與機器學習之前，先學數學、統計、機率，甚至更多。

cues.en: And while these these topics that are important, trying to learn them all before getting started, getting hands on is like trying to boil the ocean.
cues.zh: 這些確實重要，但想全部學完才動手，就像想把整片海煮沸，根本做不完。

cues.en: Instead, what we're going to be doing is focusing on building practical solutions and writing machine learning code to get insights out of data.
cues.zh: 所以我們聚焦建立實用解決方案，寫機器學習程式，從資料取得洞見。

cues.en: If you're a programmer now and had some experience with Python, by the end of this course, you'll be able to use your programming skills to build predictive machine learning models.
cues.zh: 如果已是程式設計師，也有 Python 經驗，完成課程後，就能用程式技能建立預測模型。

cues.en: Machine learning comes in three parts.
cues.zh: 機器學習分成三部分。

cues.en: Data collection, data modelling and deployment where you might take your machine learning model after you've gone through these steps here.
cues.zh: 資料蒐集、資料建模與部署；完成這些步驟之後，就能把模型帶到部署階段。

cues.en: Don't worry, we're going to cover this framework in depth shortly.
cues.zh: 別擔心，稍後會深入介紹這個框架。

cues.en: You might take this machine learning model and deploy it to to users through your application or through an API or some sort.
cues.zh: 可以透過應用程式或 API 等方式，把模型部署給使用者。

cues.en: This is what we're going to cover.
cues.zh: 這就是要涵蓋的內容。

cues.en: We're going to cover data modelling, which means you'll be able to take a data set and apply machine learning algorithms to find insights on that data set.
cues.zh: 會介紹資料建模，讓你能取得資料集、套用機器學習演算法，找出資料的洞見。

cues.en: The steps we're going to cover is, number one, create a framework.
cues.zh: 步驟第一，建立框架。

cues.en: You saw a little bit of an outline on that in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 前一張投影片已看到簡單概觀。

cues.en: Number two, we're going to match that framework once we've gone through it to available data science and machine learning tools.
cues.zh: 第二，了解框架後，對應現有的資料科學與機器學習工具。

cues.en: This means that people have already had similar problems to what we're going to try and solve in the future in the past.
cues.zh: 意思是，過去已經有人遇過與我們未來要解決的相似問題。

cues.en: And so they've created tools for those problems.
cues.zh: 也為那些問題建立了工具。

cues.en: So we're going to learn what tools are used for what machine learning projects.
cues.zh: 所以要學習不同機器學習專案，該用什麼工具。

cues.en: And then to learn all of this, we're going to learn by doing by going through projects which involve
cues.zh: 再透過親自做專案來學習，把，

cues.en: step one and step two to build a portfolio to show off your work and your skills.
cues.zh: 第一與第二步結合，建立能展示成果與技能的作品集。

cues.en: The utmost care has been taken to focus on what matters.
cues.zh: 我們很用心，確保聚焦真正重要的事。

cues.en: When I started learning, machine learning, I found myself confused about what to do.
cues.zh: 我剛學機器學習時，常困惑不知道做什麼。

cues.en: Too often, I'd spend too much time thinking about something instead of writing code and taking action.
cues.zh: 經常花太多時間思考，卻沒有寫程式採取行動。

cues.en: So we've designed this course to avoid that.
cues.zh: 所以設計課程時，刻意避免這點。

cues.en: Instead of doing anything and everything from scratch, we're going to be using what works to build practical solutions and at the same time learning about machine learning and data science.
cues.zh: 不必每件事都從零打造，而是用有效的方法建立實用方案，同時學習機器學習與資料科學。

cues.en: Now let's take a deeper look at the framework we're going to be using.
cues.zh: 接著深入看看要使用的框架。
